source_description: Name the product consistently as kenaz-ml: package sigil_ml -> kenaz_ml, distribution and CLI kameas-ml -> kenaz-ml, plus URLs, log prefixes and docs. 1738 occurrences across 165 files. The Sigil daemon this integrates with (sigild, ~/.local/share/sigild/, SIGILD_PLUGIN_URL) is a separate product and its 138 references are untouchable. Behaviour-preserving.
